name: Phonely
description: Build and A/B-test AI phone agents that answer inbound calls and run outbound campaigns, and manage agents and calls through API v1 or MCP, for businesses taking customer calls.

skills.name: Review Calls
skills.description: Lists, searches and counts calls by date, status, outcome, sentiment or words said, and reads their transcripts and recordings.

skills.name: Update Agent
skills.description: Updates a phone agent's voice, guidelines, settings, call analysis and blocked numbers; changes apply from its next call.

skills.name: Manage Knowledge
skills.description: Adds text documents and files to a phone agent's knowledge and reads, updates or deletes its knowledge sources.

skills.name: Set Call Outcome
skills.description: Sets a call's post-call outcome to record business results that only become known after the call has ended.

skills.name: Duplicate Agent
skills.description: Copies a phone agent, together with its flows and knowledge, into the same organization to start a variant.
